[[File:Ceriun_holocron.jpg|250px|thumb|The holocron]]
A '''Jedi holocron'''<ref name="CSWE Geenor">{{CSWECite|I|329|Geenor}}</ref> fulfilling the function of a [[Map/Legends|map]] existed<ref name="Tales17">{{Tales|17|All for You}}</ref> at some point by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="1000 BBY">Although {{Tales|17|All for You}} is nominally set "1,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]," which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], that book and other sources such as ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' also establish that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], whose contemporary existence is depicted as public knowledge in "All for You," entered a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]-long period of hiding in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Therefore the events of "All for You" must be set at some point by that year.</ref> At one point, it was carried aboard a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceriun]]. Although the [[Death/Legends|mortally]]-wounded Jedi [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] requested that the local [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who found him keep the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] safe until another Jedi could retrieve it, the artifact was ultimately taken instead by a [[Unidentified tattooed Sith|Sith]] who had arrived on Ceriun in search of the device.<ref name="Tales17" />
